body: This PR adds `Var.propagate_nans` which let the users propagate `NaN` across the slices of a `OutputVar`. This functionality is used in calibration because the observational data has `NaN`s at different non-temporal coordinates across the time slices of the `OutputVar`. To build a matrix of samples, we need to either do imputation or propagate the `NaN`s over the samples. The latter solution is implemented.
title: Add Var.propagate_nans
